mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_traffic_stat
AND api_route LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiRoute}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_traffic_stat (api_route, pv, uv, avg_rt, stat_time) VALUES (#{apiRoute}, #{pv}, #{uv}, #{avgRt}, #{statTime}) ON CONFLICT (api_route, stat_time) DO UPDATE SET pv = sys_traffic_stat.pv + EXCLUDED.pv, uv = GREATEST(sys_traffic_stat.uv, EXCLUDED.uv), avg_rt = EXCLUDED.avg_rt
